text:
Sam (New Hire): Hey all — I just joined, thanks! Quick calendar question: the "orientation" event on my calendar shows 09:00 but the invite body is blank (no Zoom link) and the timezone is showing PST even though I set my Google account to IST. Is that the APAC session or did I get the NA one by accident? If I can't join live, will the recording be posted?

Aisha (People Ops): Sorry about that, Sam — there are two recurring events and sometimes folks get added to the wrong one. Can you paste the invite organizer and the event ID (from the event details) here? I'll move you to the APAC instance. :wave:

Sam (New Hire): Organizer says "people-ops@redwood.com" and event ID is 878973-2029. Also the calendar invite shows "Location: Zoom" but no clickable URL — just a passcode field.

Tom - IT: Hi Sam — that passcode-only invites happen when the link doesn't sync properly across org calendars. Quick fix: open the event in the web calendar, click "More actions -> View original" and look for a line like `https://redwood.zoom.us/j/1234567890`. If you don't see it, try removing the shared calendar and resubscribing (Settings -> Calendars -> remove -> add). If still missing I can attach the link to your invite manually.

Sam (New Hire): I tried viewing original but there's only a block that says `Join Zoom Meeting` without a URL. Tried re-subscribing, same. Appreciate manual attach if possible.

Aisha (People Ops): @Tom - IT can you attach the APAC Zoom link to 878973-2029? Also note for timezone: our APAC recurrence is listed as 09:00 IST / 00:30 PST (we show the original organizer timezone which is PST, sorry for confusion). We'll normalize the display for attendees. :pray:

calendar-bot: Event updated by Aisha (People Ops) — recurrence corrected to APAC region.

Tom - IT: Done — I pasted the Zoom URL into the event description and set the passcode field to hidden so the clickable link shows up. Link: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210 passcode: 4321 (you shouldn't need the passcode now). Can you refresh your calendar and confirm?

Sam (New Hire): Got it, link is visible now, thanks! One follow-up: if I miss it, where will the recording land? Confluence or Drive?

Aisha (People Ops): Recordings are uploaded to our onboarding S3 bucket and mirrored to the new-hires Confluence page. We'll post the recording link in #new-hires within 24 hours after the session. If for some reason we miss a recording, ping me and I'll share a manual upload. :memo:

Priya (Onboarding Buddy): Hey Sam — I'm on the APAC session too. If you can't attend live, DM me and we can do a 30-min catch-up summary (I take notes each time). Welcome aboard! :raised_hands:

Sam (New Hire): Thank you everyone — really appreciate the fast help. See you on the APAC session.

Aisha (People Ops): Welcome Sam! We'll also add an explicit timezone note in the invite title ("Orientation — APAC (09:00 IST)") so it's clearer for future folks. Thanks for surfacing this. :sparkles:
